intro: A plate of nasi paprik ayam is about 650 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the white rice and the chicken. The chicken is usually fried first, then stir-fried in a spicy-sweet paprik sauce.

variants.name: Nasi paprik ayam with half rice

diet: Yes, you can. Nasi paprik is one of the more moderate choices at a tomyam shop. It has vegetables and a decent amount of protein. Calories go up when the chicken is battered and fried, and when there is a lot of stir-fry oil. Ask for less oil and less rice, and it can be an okay weekly meal.
tips: Ask for the chicken without flour coating, or stir-fried straight without deep-frying first.
Ask for extra vegetables in the paprik, like cabbage, carrot and long beans.
Take half rice and finish your vegetables and chicken first.

swap.name: Half rice + less-oil paprik chicken + extra vegetables
swap.why: Same spicy-sweet taste, but less rice and oil. Your protein stays the same.

faq.a: Paprik is a Thai-style dish. The meat is stir-fried with chilli, chilli paste, oyster sauce and vegetables. It tastes spicy, salty and a little sweet.
Depends on the shop. If you can't take spicy food, ask for less chilli when you order.

faq.q: Can I cook paprik ayam at home?
faq.a: Yes, and it's easy. Sauté onion, blended chilli and oyster sauce, then add sliced chicken and vegetables. Use just one spoon of oil and no need to fry the chicken first.
